sourceNote: rms::orm proportional-odds ordinal regression (orm_fit.rds) predicting phq9_12mo from age, sex, baseline_phq9 and gad7_total — each numeric predictor as a 4-knot restricted cubic spline. Coefficients were parsed offline in Python (the `rdata` package) since no R runtime was available; see src/lib/riskModel.ts for the full equation and caveats. Regenerate with scripts/export-model-coefficients.py against the real .rds file rather than hand-editing the numbers.
